title: Psalms Bible Quiz - Chapter 14
description: Ten questions on Psalms 14: the fool who says there is no God, Yahweh looking down from heaven, and the hope of salvation out of Zion.

questions.text: What has the fool said in his heart?
questions.explanation: Psalms 14:1 says the fool has said in his heart, "There is no God."

questions.text: From where did Yahweh look down on the children of men?
questions.explanation: Psalms 14:2 says Yahweh looked down from heaven on the children of men.

questions.text: What was Yahweh looking for when he looked down?
questions.explanation: Psalms 14:2 says he looked to see if there were any who understood, who sought after God.

answers.text: Any who understood and sought after God
Any who were strong in battle

questions.text: According to verse 3, what have they all together become?
questions.explanation: Psalms 14:3 says they have all gone aside and together become corrupt.

questions.text: What does verse 3 say about anyone who does good?
questions.explanation: Psalms 14:3 says, "There is no one who does good, no, not one."

answers.text: There is no one, not one

questions.text: How do the workers of iniquity eat up God's people?
questions.explanation: Psalms 14:4 says they eat up my people as they eat bread.

questions.text: Why were the evildoers in great fear?
questions.explanation: Psalms 14:5 says they were in great fear, for God is in the generation of the righteous.

answers.text: God is in the generation of the righteous
A great army came against them
The earth shook beneath their feet
Their king had died in battle

questions.text: According to verse 6, who is the refuge of the poor man?
questions.explanation: Psalms 14:6 says, "You frustrate the plan of the poor, because Yahweh is his refuge."

questions.text: Out of where does the psalmist long for the salvation of Israel to come?
questions.explanation: Psalms 14:7 says, "Oh that the salvation of Israel would come out of Zion!"

questions.text: When Yahweh restores the fortunes of his people, who shall rejoice?
questions.explanation: Psalms 14:7 says then Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.
